name: Commuting a CNOT target past a CNOT control
summary: When the target of one CNOT is the control of the next, they can be swapped at the cost of an extra CNOT.
description:
Two CNOTs where the target of the first is the control of the second do not commute. Swapping them introduces a third CNOT from the first control to the second target: $\mathrm{CNOT}_{12}\mathrm{CNOT}_{01} = \mathrm{CNOT}_{01}\mathrm{CNOT}_{02}\mathrm{CNOT}_{12}$ (in operator notation, so that the rightmost gate is applied first).

In the ZX-calculus this is a direct application of the [bialgebra rule](../bialgebra/) to the X-spider of the first target and the Z-spider of the second control. CNOTs sharing only controls or only targets commute by [spider fusion](../spider-fusion/).
